checks: Selecting an in-flight JPEG prefetch reuses one un-aborted HTTP request; loading edits stay blocked and displayed pixels match the target frame.
A selected in-flight prefetch returning 429 retries once at foreground priority and displays the correct frame.
Rapid navigation away from a promoted slow prefetch cancels it; a late old response cannot replace the final requested frame.
The 8GiB device profile retains 21 actual 1080p images; revisiting the tracked early image reuses the same decoded object URL without HTTP or decoding.
After 40 actual 1080p JPEGs exceed the 256MiB decoded budget, old decoded URLs are released; the compressed layer serves a correct-pixel revisit without HTTP.
unknown memory uses a conservative decoded budget and still revisits an evicted 1080p frame from the compressed cache without HTTP.
low memory uses a conservative decoded budget and still revisits an evicted 1080p frame from the compressed cache without HTTP.
Leaving a workspace aborts requests and releases decoded URLs; returning fetches again rather than reusing old compressed data, and logout releases the new workspace.
